quote.author: The Falcoholic
quote.text:
The Falcons vowed not to punt on the season, but they've fumbled it away instead.

With a three game losing streak, the year is lost, and the need for a major overhaul of the roster is beyond evident

items.title: At the center of the Jessie Bates trade: comp picks.
items.author: Seth Walder
items.body_excerpt:
At the center of the Jessie Bates trade: comp picks.

With >$110M in 2027 cap space, the Falcons were basically boxed in to dealing Bates because they likely wouldn't get a comp pick for him.

But cap-strapped Jaguars likely will. 

Grades!

items.title: The Falcons are getting two draft picks, including a No. 2, for a player they probably were not going to (be able to) re-sign. But I can't help but view the trade of Jessie Bates as, "F*** it. We don't care about this season." The dude can still ball.
